<article title="Product care">
Wash technical shells and down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash, never regular detergent, and tumble dry on low. Down jackets need two or three clean tennis balls in the dryer to restore loft.

Waterproof coatings wear down with use. If water stops beading on a shell, wash it and apply a spray-on re-proofing treatment; this restores the coating without affecting the warranty.

Store sleeping bags and down items uncompressed in a dry place. Long-term compression permanently reduces insulation.

</article>

Customer first name: George
<request>
water no longer beads on my shell
my rain shell used to be waterproof but now soaks through. is it defective or does it need treatment?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi George,

Thanks for reaching out. Water no longer beading on a shell is usually because the waterproof coating has worn down with use, which isn't a defect. Our care guidance recommends washing the jacket and then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment, which restores the coating and does not affect the warranty. Wash it on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash (not regular detergent) and tumble dry on low.

If the jacket still soaks through after this, a Fernwood Outfitters support specialist will follow up with you about next steps.

Warm regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support
